title: Kale and Oven-Dried Tomato Lasagne with Potato and Ricotta
changes_from_base: Slowly oven-dried plum tomatoes, rosemary and garlic kale, thin slices of blanched potato and a plain ricotta layer replace the meat ragù and béchamel, finished with grated ricotta salata.
summary: A hearty vegetable lasagne stacking sweet oven-dried tomatoes, garlicky kale and tender potato slices with a creamy ricotta layer.

ingredients.item: medium plum tomatoes (about 1700 g), stem end trimmed, halved lengthwise
fine sea salt or table salt
large baking potatoes (about 500 g), peeled and thinly sliced
kale (about 6 heads), stalks removed, coarsely chopped
fine sea salt or table salt
fine sea salt or table salt
dried lasagne sheets (9), cooked and well drained

steps.title: Dry
steps.text: Heat the oven to 95 °C, brush the 28 halved tomatoes with the 10 ml oil, lay them skin side down on the tray and sprinkle with ¾ tsp salt and ¼ tsp pepper, then bake 4-6 hours until shrunk to about a quarter of their size but still juicy, cool and quarter.

steps.title: Blanch
steps.text: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to the boil, blanch the 500 g sliced potatoes for 7 min and drain.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Heat the 5 ml oil over medium, add the garlic and 5 tsp rosemary for 30 seconds, then add the 1200 g kale, stir once, cover and cook 12 min before stirring in 1 tsp salt and ¼ tsp chilli flakes.

steps.title: Whisk
steps.text: Turn the oven to 175 °C and whisk the 425 g ricotta, beaten egg, ½ tsp salt and some pepper together.

steps.title: Layer
steps.text: Grease the dish, lay 3 sheets in the base, spread with half the ricotta, then half the kale, half the potatoes and a third of the tomatoes, and repeat once.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Top with the last 3 sheets, the rest of the kale, the 3 tbsp ricotta salata and the remaining tomatoes.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Cover with foil and bake 30 min, then cut into 6.

tips: Dry the tomatoes slowly so they concentrate in flavour while staying soft.
Blanch the potato slices just until barely tender so they finish in the oven.
Grate the ricotta salata finely so it melts evenly over the top.
storage: The tomatoes can be dried a day ahead and chilled until you are ready to assemble. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
